expect.offline: RANDOM Camera Motion draws one of 15 motions with Math.random() and Global SETTINGS makes cluster_id from Date.now() and Math.random(), so the prompt and Cluster ID differ per run on either side; the fixture answers Luma the same whatever the prompt. The callback URL is placeholder text sent to Luma as data, never called. Luma's and Airtable's credentials are the bench's dummies.
